# AI-bottlenecks corpus sources

Each file holds one arXiv paper, fetched from arXiv on 2026-11-21. Papers released under CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0 contribute their body text (PDF text extraction with pypdf, before the references, capped at about 40,000 characters); the text is modified only by whitespace clean-up and the holdout removals described in `holdout.md`. All other papers (arXiv non-exclusive licence, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-NC-ND) contribute only their abstract, which arXiv releases as CC0 1.0 metadata (https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html). Copyright in each paper remains with its authors; see the URL for attribution.
